description: This file contains utility functions for the Mattermost server, including slice manipulation, IP address extraction, URL validation, caching, and number rounding.

methods.name: RemoveStringFromSlice
methods.description: Removes the first occurrence of a string from a slice of strings.

methods.name: RemoveStringsFromSlice
methods.description: Removes all specified strings from a slice of strings.

methods.name: StringArrayIntersection
methods.description: Returns the intersection of two string slices.

methods.name: RemoveDuplicatesFromStringArray
methods.description: Removes duplicate strings from a slice.

methods.name: StringSliceDiff
methods.description: Returns elements in the first slice that are not in the second slice.

methods.name: RemoveElementFromSliceAtIndex
methods.description: Removes an element at a specified index from a slice.

methods.name: GetIPAddress
methods.description: Extracts the client's IP address from an HTTP request, considering trusted proxy headers.

methods.name: GetHostnameFromSiteURL
methods.description: Extracts hostname from a site URL string.

methods.name: GetURLWithCache
methods.description: Fetches JSON data from a URL with caching support.

methods.name: AppendQueryParamsToURL
methods.description: Appends query parameters to a base URL.

methods.name: ValidateWebAuthRedirectUrl
methods.description: Validates a redirect URL during OAuth/SAML against the site URL.

methods.name: IsValidMobileAuthRedirectURL
methods.description: Checks if a redirect URL matches allowed mobile app URL schemes.

methods.name: IsMobileRequest
methods.description: Determines if an HTTP request originates from a mobile device based on User-Agent.

methods.name: RoundOffToZeroes
methods.description: Converts a float to an int, rounding to the most significant digit, setting others to zero.

methods.name: RoundOffToZeroesResolution
methods.description: Rounds a float to a resolution based on minResolution, with special handling for small numbers.
